sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, host Alsager Town on Saturday at 15:00. The leaders arrive in excellent form with five consecutive wins before a recent draw, and face an Alsager side struggling at the bottom with just four points from ten games. This should represent a significant opportunity for Sandbach to extend their lead at the summit.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town travel to Dawley Town in a fixture with title-race implications, with Stafford looking to close the two-point gap to leaders Sandbach. Third-ranked AFC Bridgnorth welcome Eccleshall in a match between two strong performers—Bridgnorth recovering from their sole recent loss with consecutive wins, while Eccleshall seek to bounce back after a defeat. Wolverhampton Casuals host Wednesfield Community in a local derby between mid-table sides, with Casuals in solid recent form. Bilston Town, fifth in the table, travel to Foley Meir in a fixture between mid-pack rivals. Barnton entertain Shawbury United in a match between teams of contrasting form—Barnton steadier while Shawbury endure a difficult five-game losing streak. Market Drayton Town visit New Mills, with both sides battling in the bottom half and seeking consistency. Cheadle Heath Nomads, struggling with just seven points, travel to in-form Crewe in a clash between relegation-zone sides. Brereton Social host Widnes Town at the bottom of the table in a fixture between two of the division's weakest performers. Finally, Crewe face Allscott Heath in a match between sides in the lower reaches of the table.
